responsibility: Declares channel-based decimal text I/O for SHORTINT and SHORTCARD values. It provides the explicit-channel interface for reading signed and unsigned short whole numbers and writing them in a requested minimum field width, complementing WholeIO and LongWholeIO for the short integer types.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public declaration side of ShortWholeIO: it only specifies the exported SHORTINT/SHORTCARD channel I/O procedures and their contracts, unlike ShortWholeIO.mod which contains the scanner-driven parsing, range handling, and string-formatting implementation.
